data.name: مُزَمِّل
data.gender_notes: مُزَمِّل is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Wrapped in garments, The Enshrouded One
data.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل زَمَّلَ الذي يعني تغطِّي والتحف بثيابه. The name مُزَمِّل carries the meaning “Wrapped in garments, The Enshrouded One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose مُزَمِّل usually hope their child will grow to embody wrapped in garments, the enshrouded one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reflects humility, modesty, and divine closeness — a soul quietly devoted to its Creator.
data.etymology: مُزَمِّل belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wrapped in garments, The Enshrouded One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of مُزَمِّل total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: مُزَمِّل
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُزَمِّل هو اسم ذكري يعود إلى الجذر العربي ز م ل، والذي يعني الغطاء أو اللف، ويتعلق بالقرآن الكريم حيث يوصف النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم بأنه مُزَمِّل، أي الذي يغطي أو يلف بالرحمة والإحسان

in_urdu.name: مُزَمِّل
in_urdu.meaning: جو کور لیتا ہے یا لپیٹتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُزَمِّل ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی gốc ز م ل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کور یا لپیٹ، اور یہ قرآن پاک سے منسلک ہے جہاں نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کو مُزَمِّل کے نام سے یاد کیا جاتا ہے، یعنی جو رحمت اور احسان سے کور لیتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुज़म्मिल
in_hindi.meaning: जो ढकता है या लपेटता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुज़म्मिल एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी मूल ز म ल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है ढकना या लपेटना, और यह कुरान से जुड़ा हुआ है जहां नबी मुहम्मद साहब को मुज़म्मिल के नाम से याद किया जाता है, अर्थात जो दया और भलाई से ढकता है

in_pashto.name: مُزَمِّل
in_pashto.long_meaning: مُزَمِّل د عربی ریښې ز م ل څخه اخیستل شوی یو نارینه نوم دی، چې معنی یې پوښول یا ټولول دي، او دا د قرآن sharif سره تړلی دی چېرې چې نبي محمد صلی الله علیه وسلم ته د مُزَمِّل په نوم یادونه شوې، يعنې چې رحمت او ښېگړتیا پوښي

in_english.name: مُزَمِّل
in_english.meaning: the one who covers or wraps
in_english.long_meaning: Muzammil is a male name derived from the Arabic root z m l, meaning to cover or wrap, and is associated with the Quran where the Prophet Muhammad is described as Muzammil, meaning the one who covers or wraps with mercy and kindness

pronunciation.urdu: مُزَمِّل کی تلفظ میں مُزَم کا اعلیٰ اور مل کا زبر ہوتا ہے
pronunciation.hindi: मुज़म्मिल का उच्चारण मुज़म का ऊंचा स्वर और मिल का नीचा स्वर होता है
pronunciation.pashto: مُزَمِّل د تلفظ په توګه مُزَم لوړ او مل ښکته دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Muzamil highlights the significance of modest dressing in Islamic culture. Dressing modestly is considered an essential act of faith, and wearing garments that cover from head to toes is encouraged for both men and women. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a presentable and respectable appearance, which is crucial for establishing a positive image within the community and society at large.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Muzamil has a profound significance. It is derived from Surah Al-Muzzammil in the Holy Quran, which is a chapter that emphasizes the importance of prayer and devotion. The name serves as a daily reminder for the person bearing it to engage in ongoing spiritual preparation through connecting with Allah (SWT) and striving to lead a righteous life. The name represents the idea of being wrapped in a form of spiritual clothing - the attire of faith and piety that covers one's soul. Moreover, it alludes to the concept of humbly submitting oneself to the will of Allah and seeking refuge in His mercy, which is a fundamental aspect of Islamic spirituality.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Muzamil in Arabic means 'the one who is often absent'. Spiritually, it represents the struggle and longing of a believer for Allah's presence, even when physical absence prevails. It is a reminder to strive for nearness to Allah, despite the challenges and distractions of life.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Muzamil ibn Abi Sabra was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and took part in several battles.
historical_references.context: Muzamil was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and played an active role in the early Islamic community.
